Description.SourceString:
// Welcome to WARDOGS
Thank you for purchasing our game.

Welcome to Early Access Season 02. This update brings a new weather variant 'rain' as well as new weapons, vehicles, attachments and buildables, alongside a brand new vendor and balance changes to shake up the metagame. Season 01 XP & Cash progression has been reset. Any cash you had remaining at the end of the season 01 has been automatically converted into gold bars, which you can use to unlock permanent cosmetics for your account in the gold market. All XP and tracked stats have been banked into our backend for use with future in game systems once implemented.

As a reminder - WARDOGS is an early access game. If you haven't watched our '10 Reasons NOT to buy WARDOGS' video, we highly recommend you do to understand that this is a long road to 1.0 release. This is a sandbox that rewards teamplay, creativity and freedom, so make sure to use proximity chat for the best experience.

If you see any bugs or cheaters, please report them ingame via the scoreboard or use the appropriate bots in our Official Discord.

Thanks,
BULKHEAD

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Use the distance gauge on the right of your reticle and the compass on top of your screen to range your shot.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Use the distance gauge on the right of your reticle and the compass on top of your screen to range your shot.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: An artillery shell will auto-chamber after a short delay. Quick-reload combinations can speed up this process, but any mistakes will reset the progress.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: An artillery shell will auto-chamber after a short delay. Quick-reload combinations can speed up this process, but any mistakes will reset the progress.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: A FOB is a deployable used to establish a Forward Operating Base and claim territory for your team. Once claimed, advanced structures can be built there.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: A FOB is a deployable used to establish a Forward Operating Base and claim territory for your team. Once claimed, advanced structures can be built there.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Use hammers to place and build structures. Larger structures require larger hammers and a FOB, and must be within the FOB's radius.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Use hammers to place and build structures. Larger structures require larger hammers and a FOB, and must be within the FOB's radius.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Building a structure requires Build Supplies. Supplies can be stored in a FOB or in your inventory, and are consumed as you build.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Building a structure requires Build Supplies. Supplies can be stored in a FOB or in your inventory, and are consumed as you build.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Snapping lets you quickly align and connect buildables. Toggle it on or off as needed.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Snapping lets you quickly align and connect buildables. Toggle it on or off as needed.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString:
XP in Wardogs is earned per role:

• Assault 
• Recon
• Support
• Medic
• Pilot
• Driver

Complete role-specific actions to gain XP for that role (e.g., reviving grants Medic XP).
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString:
XP in Wardogs is earned per role:

• Assault 
• Recon
• Support
• Medic
• Pilot
• Driver

Complete role-specific actions to gain XP for that role (e.g., reviving grants Medic XP).

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Your Career Level combines all role levels. Leveling up grants items that benefit all roles.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Your Career Level combines all role levels. Leveling up grants items that benefit all roles.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Purchase a remote detonator and C4 charges. Select the detonator, then throw the charges and detonate.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Purchase a remote detonator and C4 charges. Select the detonator, then throw the charges and detonate.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Anti-tank mines are purchased at the Equipment Vendor and can destroy or disable vehicles.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Anti-tank mines are purchased at the Equipment Vendor and can destroy or disable vehicles.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Claymores are purchased at the Equipment Vendor. They detonate when anyone passes in front, friendlies included!
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Claymores are purchased at the Equipment Vendor. They detonate when anyone passes in front, friendlies included!

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Throw under or over arm. Once the smoke deploys, move through and use the cover.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Throw under or over arm. Once the smoke deploys, move through and use the cover.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Throw under or over arm. Grenades excel at clearing positions.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Throw under or over arm. Grenades excel at clearing positions.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Dashboard icons and smoke indicate your vehicle's status. Bail out or repair it before it's destroyed.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Dashboard icons and smoke indicate your vehicle's status. Bail out or repair it before it's destroyed.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: If a seat has multiple weapons available, you can cycle between them.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: If a seat has multiple weapons available, you can cycle between them.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: You can cycle through magnification levels when occupying a vehicle weapon seat.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: You can cycle through magnification levels when occupying a vehicle weapon seat.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Your current health is displayed in a bar at the bottom right of the screen. Keep an eye on this while in combat.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Your current health is displayed in a bar at the bottom right of the screen. Keep an eye on this while in combat.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: When your health reaches zero, you enter the critical state. If you aren't revived in time, you'll bleed out and respawn at Headquarters.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: When your health reaches zero, you enter the critical state. If you aren't revived in time, you'll bleed out and respawn at Headquarters.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: If a friendly player is in a critical state, get within range, interact, and select Revive. Reviving with no medical gear takes time, so watch your surroundings.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: If a friendly player is in a critical state, get within range, interact, and select Revive. Reviving with no medical gear takes time, so watch your surroundings.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: If a friendly player is in a critical state, get within range, interact, and select drag. Interact again while dragging to drop them.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: If a friendly player is in a critical state, get within range, interact, and select drag. Interact again while dragging to drop them.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: To enter a vehicle, approach it and use the interaction prompt to initiate the Enter Vehicle action.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: To enter a vehicle, approach it and use the interaction prompt to initiate the Enter Vehicle action.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Vehicles are purchased in a locked state. Their owners can choose to unlock them for their squad, or everyone in the game.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Vehicles are purchased in a locked state. Their owners can choose to unlock them for their squad, or everyone in the game.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: You can switch seats within a vehicle, but note, switching isn't instant and will take a moment.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: You can switch seats within a vehicle, but note, switching isn't instant and will take a moment.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Exit a vehicle by using the interaction menu. Press and Hold the Exit Vehicle option.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Exit a vehicle by using the interaction menu. Press and Hold the Exit Vehicle option.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Drivers and pilots can cycle between first- and third-person cameras. When in third person, you can also enter free-look, allowing you to see more of your surrounding area.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Drivers and pilots can cycle between first- and third-person cameras. When in third person, you can also enter free-look, allowing you to see more of your surrounding area.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Purchase ammo & supply crates for your vehicle. When sitting in a driver or pilot seat in the vehicle spawn, you can open the Garage Vendor and select your desired tab and click on your desired items to purchase them.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Purchase ammo & supply crates for your vehicle. When sitting in a driver or pilot seat in the vehicle spawn, you can open the Garage Vendor and select your desired tab and click on your desired items to purchase them.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Vehicle crews share responsibilities. The driver or pilot navigates the battlefield, while gunners tracks targets and eliminates the enemy. Rewards and penalties will be shared!
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Vehicle crews share responsibilities. The driver or pilot navigates the battlefield, while gunners tracks targets and eliminates the enemy. Rewards and penalties will be shared!

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Items you pick up or buy are stored in your inventory.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Items you pick up or buy are stored in your inventory.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Items often need to be equipped in a Quick Access slot to use them. The Weapon and Tac Vest slots are Quick Access slots.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Items often need to be equipped in a Quick Access slot to use them. The Weapon and Tac Vest slots are Quick Access slots.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Quick Access slots and their contents are shown on the Quick Access Bar at the bottom of the screen.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Quick Access slots and their contents are shown on the Quick Access Bar at the bottom of the screen.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: You must select an item in a Quick Access slot to use it.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: You must select an item in a Quick Access slot to use it.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Deployables must be placed on flat, unobstructed ground. When equipped, the preview color shows whether the location is valid.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Deployables must be placed on flat, unobstructed ground. When equipped, the preview color shows whether the location is valid.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Players in a critical state, corpse bags, and ground items can all be looted. Move close to the target to see a prompt to Loot or Interact (e.g., a player body).
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Players in a critical state, corpse bags, and ground items can all be looted. Move close to the target to see a prompt to Loot or Interact (e.g., a player body).

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Use the tactical map to navigate; zoom in and out and pan around to spot key information that helps you plan your next move.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Use the tactical map to navigate; zoom in and out and pan around to spot key information that helps you plan your next move.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: The mini map shows whether you are in the Control Zone, the Hot Zone, or No Man's Land. Take note of area titles, zone borders, and your location when navigating your surroundings.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: The mini map shows whether you are in the Control Zone, the Hot Zone, or No Man's Land. Take note of area titles, zone borders, and your location when navigating your surroundings.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString:
Downed allies and various faction requests will appear on the mini map. 
Check it frequently to see how you can help your faction and earn some extra cash!
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString:
Downed allies and various faction requests will appear on the mini map. 
Check it frequently to see how you can help your faction and earn some extra cash!

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: The color of the Control Zone shows control: red / green / blue indicate the owning faction; orange means it’s contested.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: The color of the Control Zone shows control: red / green / blue indicate the owning faction; orange means it’s contested.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: The Ping Wheel is a powerful tool which you can use to make faction requests, to send squad commands, and to quickly communicate with local players.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: The Ping Wheel is a powerful tool which you can use to make faction requests, to send squad commands, and to quickly communicate with local players.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: You can mantle over objects of different heights; the higher the obstacle, the longer the mantle takes.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: You can mantle over objects of different heights; the higher the obstacle, the longer the mantle takes.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Use crouch and prone to take cover and reduce your silhouette, making you harder to hit.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Use crouch and prone to take cover and reduce your silhouette, making you harder to hit.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: You can interact with objects in the world, such as doors. When several actions are available, an options list is shown so you can pick one.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: You can interact with objects in the world, such as doors. When several actions are available, an options list is shown so you can pick one.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString:
Earning cash in Wardogs is easy. Almost every action rewards cash, including:
 
• Being in the CZ &  HZ
• Killing
• Reviving
• Repairing
• Building
• Transporting players to the CZ
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString:
Earning cash in Wardogs is easy. Almost every action rewards cash, including:
 
• Being in the CZ &  HZ
• Killing
• Reviving
• Repairing
• Building
• Transporting players to the CZ

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Spend cash at Vendors to buy items and vehicles. Short on funds? Pick up the free weapon and go get some kills!
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Spend cash at Vendors to buy items and vehicles. Short on funds? Pick up the free weapon and go get some kills!

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: The cash you earn in a match is persistent. Whatever you leave the match with, is what you have to spend in the next match.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: The cash you earn in a match is persistent. Whatever you leave the match with, is what you have to spend in the next match.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Vests provide Quick Access slots, used to swiftly switch between equipped items.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Vests provide Quick Access slots, used to swiftly switch between equipped items.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Backpacks increase your carry capacity, allowing a bigger loadout.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Backpacks increase your carry capacity, allowing a bigger loadout.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Helmets and armor reduce damage from gunfire. Superior armor covers more of the body and offers better protection against larger-caliber rounds.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Helmets and armor reduce damage from gunfire. Superior armor covers more of the body and offers better protection against larger-caliber rounds.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: The Traversal slot is dedicated to movement gear, for example, parachutes.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: The Traversal slot is dedicated to movement gear, for example, parachutes.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Interact with the Equipment Vendor, open the weapons tab, and pick your weapon. Use filters to quickly find your favorite.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Interact with the Equipment Vendor, open the weapons tab, and pick your weapon. Use filters to quickly find your favorite.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Once you’ve bought a weapon, press the ammo button to buy the correct magazines and ammo for it.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Once you’ve bought a weapon, press the ammo button to buy the correct magazines and ammo for it.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: The attachment button becomes available once you've bought a weapon.  Purchase attachments to change the way your weapon handles.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: The attachment button becomes available once you've bought a weapon.  Purchase attachments to change the way your weapon handles.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString:
The three ammo types in Wardogs include:

Full Metal Jacket (FMJ): Standard ammo; a solid all-rounder.

Hollow Point (HP): Higher damage to unarmored body parts; less effective against armor.

Armor-Piercing (AP): Higher damage against armored targets; less effective on unarmored body parts.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString:
The three ammo types in Wardogs include:

Full Metal Jacket (FMJ): Standard ammo; a solid all-rounder.

Hollow Point (HP): Higher damage to unarmored body parts; less effective against armor.

Armor-Piercing (AP): Higher damage against armored targets; less effective on unarmored body parts.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Each faction offers one FREE weapon, so you'll never deploy without being combat-ready.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Each faction offers one FREE weapon, so you'll never deploy without being combat-ready.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Repair and refuel vehicles by returning to Headquarters. This doesn't come free, you will be charged.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Repair and refuel vehicles by returning to Headquarters. This doesn't come free, you will be charged.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: The Fuel Can is a purchasable item, used to provide emergency fuel during combat or travel. It can be stored in your personal inventory or vehicle inventories and obtained from Headquarters , Supply Crates, or looted from other players.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: The Fuel Can is a purchasable item, used to provide emergency fuel during combat or travel. It can be stored in your personal inventory or vehicle inventories and obtained from Headquarters , Supply Crates, or looted from other players.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Use the Vehicle Repair Tool to repair damaged vehicles. There are three types; pick the one that fits budget. It uses batteries.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Use the Vehicle Repair Tool to repair damaged vehicles. There are three types; pick the one that fits budget. It uses batteries.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Helicopter engines must spool up before takeoff, this can take a few moments and is done by the pilot.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Helicopter engines must spool up before takeoff, this can take a few moments and is done by the pilot.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Be careful with the rotor blades, if they hit objects, they will break.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Be careful with the rotor blades, if they hit objects, they will break.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Flares can be used to momentarily prevent heat-seeking projectiles from locking onto your helicopter.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Flares can be used to momentarily prevent heat-seeking projectiles from locking onto your helicopter.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: While aiming down sights, you can focus, which will reduce your weapon sway.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: While aiming down sights, you can focus, which will reduce your weapon sway.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Ammo persists per magazine. If you reload with 1 round left, that 1-round mag stays in your backpack and will be reinserted when you cycle back to it.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Ammo persists per magazine. If you reload with 1 round left, that 1-round mag stays in your backpack and will be reinserted when you cycle back to it.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Use the ammo consolidation button in your inventory to combine rounds of the same caliber, maximizing the number of full magazines.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Use the ammo consolidation button in your inventory to combine rounds of the same caliber, maximizing the number of full magazines.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Many weapons support multiple fire modes (e.g., semi-auto, burst, full-auto). Choose the mode that suits the fight.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Many weapons support multiple fire modes (e.g., semi-auto, burst, full-auto). Choose the mode that suits the fight.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Zeroing makes the reticle accurate at a chosen range. While aiming down sight, adjust the zero up or down to match your target distance.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Zeroing makes the reticle accurate at a chosen range. While aiming down sight, adjust the zero up or down to match your target distance.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: The Spawn Vehicle is a mobile transport unit accessible via the Spawn Board at your team’s Headquarters. Interacting with the board allows you to spawn into an available seat inside the vehicle. This helps you quickly return to the action, reducing travel time between Headquarters and the Control Zone.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: The Spawn Vehicle is a mobile transport unit accessible via the Spawn Board at your team’s Headquarters. Interacting with the board allows you to spawn into an available seat inside the vehicle. This helps you quickly return to the action, reducing travel time between Headquarters and the Control Zone.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Upon any team reaching 20 points from holding the Control Zone, each of the three teams will be granted a free Spawn Vehicle, which spawns at their Headquarters.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Upon any team reaching 20 points from holding the Control Zone, each of the three teams will be granted a free Spawn Vehicle, which spawns at their Headquarters.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: You can only spawn into your team’s Spawn Vehicle from the Spawn Board once its stationary inside the Control Zone, with vacant seats and a suitable amount of Hit Points.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: You can only spawn into your team’s Spawn Vehicle from the Spawn Board once its stationary inside the Control Zone, with vacant seats and a suitable amount of Hit Points.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: If your team’s Spawn Vehicle takes enough damage, it will be destroyed. The Spawn Board then becomes inactive until a new Spawn Vehicle appears at Headquarters after a short cooldown.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: If your team’s Spawn Vehicle takes enough damage, it will be destroyed. The Spawn Board then becomes inactive until a new Spawn Vehicle appears at Headquarters after a short cooldown.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: A basic tool used for long-range reconnaissance.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: A basic tool used for long-range reconnaissance.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: A precision optical tool used to measure distance from targets.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: A precision optical tool used to measure distance from targets.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: A precision optical tool used to measure distance from targets with in-built infrared to detect and mark heat signatures.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: A precision optical tool used to measure distance from targets with in-built infrared to detect and mark heat signatures.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: You can create a new squad by accessing the Squad Menu and selecting the 'Create Squad' option. Whoever creates the squad instantly becomes the squad leader and has control over the squad's management.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: You can create a new squad by accessing the Squad Menu and selecting the 'Create Squad' option. Whoever creates the squad instantly becomes the squad leader and has control over the squad's management.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: To join an already existing squad, open the Squad Menu and select 'Join Squad' icon. It's also worth noting, you'll only be able to join an 'Open Squad'.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: To join an already existing squad, open the Squad Menu and select 'Join Squad' icon. It's also worth noting, you'll only be able to join an 'Open Squad'.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: All squadmates trackers are colored gold, making them easier to distinguish from the rest of your team.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: All squadmates trackers are colored gold, making them easier to distinguish from the rest of your team.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Squad Chat provides private text and voice channels for you and your squad. Allowing  focused and strategic discussions without interference from other players.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Squad Chat provides private text and voice channels for you and your squad. Allowing  focused and strategic discussions without interference from other players.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: After purchasing a vehicle from the Vendor, you can Squad Lock it. This results in the vehicle only being accessible by Squadmates, unless the vehicle owner chooses to Unlock it to all teammates.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: After purchasing a vehicle from the Vendor, you can Squad Lock it. This results in the vehicle only being accessible by Squadmates, unless the vehicle owner chooses to Unlock it to all teammates.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: The Squad Ping System allows you to easily mark a location or a threat for other squad members, without needing to use the Voice Channels or the Chat Box.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: The Squad Ping System allows you to easily mark a location or a threat for other squad members, without needing to use the Voice Channels or the Chat Box.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: You can repair damaged vehicles with the repair tool. You must fix each damaged location to restore the vehicle to full health.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: You can repair damaged vehicles with the repair tool. You must fix each damaged location to restore the vehicle to full health.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: A resource consumed by drills and defibrillators to power them.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: A resource consumed by drills and defibrillators to power them.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Purchase fuel cans from Vendors. Use one at a vehicle’s fuel point to refuel in the field.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Purchase fuel cans from Vendors. Use one at a vehicle’s fuel point to refuel in the field.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Buy supply crates from the Garage Vendor, fill them with weapons and equipment, and deploy them in the field. Choose contents your team needs to maximize profit. View your team's crates and their contents on the Tac Map.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Buy supply crates from the Garage Vendor, fill them with weapons and equipment, and deploy them in the field. Choose contents your team needs to maximize profit. View your team's crates and their contents on the Tac Map.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Battles pit three 33-player factions against each other. Each time you play, choose to fight for Lonestar, Valkyra, or Manticore.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Battles pit three 33-player factions against each other. Each time you play, choose to fight for Lonestar, Valkyra, or Manticore.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Your primary objective is the Control Zone (CZ) at the center of the map.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Your primary objective is the Control Zone (CZ) at the center of the map.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Every player in the Control Zone contributes 1 point to their team's Faction Count. The team with the highest total, controls the Control Zone.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Every player in the Control Zone contributes 1 point to their team's Faction Count. The team with the highest total, controls the Control Zone.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: A Match Point is awarded to the faction in control of the Control Zone when the tick bar fills.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: A Match Point is awarded to the faction in control of the Control Zone when the tick bar fills.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: The first Faction to reach 100 Match Points, wins the match.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: The first Faction to reach 100 Match Points, wins the match.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: The Hot Zone (HZ) is a roaming sub-zone inside the Control Zone. Players in the Hot Zone count for twice the Faction Count and earn extra cash.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: The Hot Zone (HZ) is a roaming sub-zone inside the Control Zone. Players in the Hot Zone count for twice the Faction Count and earn extra cash.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Use your parachute to control your fall; you can cut it while airborne if necessary.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Use your parachute to control your fall; you can cut it while airborne if necessary.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Sports parachutes offer more control than basic parachutes, just be careful not to land too fast.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Sports parachutes offer more control than basic parachutes, just be careful not to land too fast.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Small, stackable healing item. Use on yourself or an ally.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Small, stackable healing item. Use on yourself or an ally.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Full heal, non-stackable healing item. Use on yourself or an ally.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Full heal, non-stackable healing item. Use on yourself or an ally.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Healing applies over time and stops if you move away. Equipping a Med Bag speeds up revives, but self-use quickly drains its durability.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Healing applies over time and stops if you move away. Equipping a Med Bag speeds up revives, but self-use quickly drains its durability.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Activate the Stim Pen to temporarily increase sprint and Tac Sprint speed.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Activate the Stim Pen to temporarily increase sprint and Tac Sprint speed.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: First charge the defibrillator; then release to instantly revive a friendly player within range. Requires Batteries to operate.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: First charge the defibrillator; then release to instantly revive a friendly player within range. Requires Batteries to operate.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Use this free medical item for faster revives. Though, the resuscitator can only be used once per purchase.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Use this free medical item for faster revives. Though, the resuscitator can only be used once per purchase.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Equipment Vendors sell Weapons, Gear, Equipment and Items.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Equipment Vendors sell Weapons, Gear, Equipment and Items.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: You need a backpack to carry magazines and other essential equipment. Watch your carry weight, the more you take, the slower you move.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: You need a backpack to carry magazines and other essential equipment. Watch your carry weight, the more you take, the slower you move.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: Vehicle vendors sell cars, tanks, helicopters and more. You can collect your vehicle near the main road to the Control Zone.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: Vehicle vendors sell cars, tanks, helicopters and more. You can collect your vehicle near the main road to the Control Zone.

HeaderVideoDescription.SourceString: The Garage Vendor is accessible while seated in the driver’s or gunner’s seat. It sells vehicle supplies, such as ammunition, and items you can store in the vehicle inventory.
HeaderVideoDescription.LocalizedString: The Garage Vendor is accessible while seated in the driver’s or gunner’s seat. It sells vehicle supplies, such as ammunition, and items you can store in the vehicle inventory.
